summary_1line: Cursed with old age, King Yayati borrows youth from his son Puru, later rewarding him with kingship while cursing the disobedient Yadu.

image_candidates.scene_text: The aged, stooped King Yayati pleads with his sons while young Puru stands with folded palms agreeing to take his father’s old age.
Youth restored, Yayati performs grand sacrifices as priests and sacred fires blaze around the rejuvenated king.
King Yayati places the royal crown upon Puru while the rejected Yadu stands aside under his father’s harsh curse.
